summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Iteration 7 features: club-specific question categories, matchmaking endpoints, and ELO-based skill ranking. All 12 backend API tests pass (100%). Frontend matchmaking UI verified with Playwright showing ranked match search, wait time, skill range, queue count, and cancel functionality.

club_specific_categories: GET /api/questions/categories returns 85+ categories including club-specific ones
Club categories like 'Manchester United-History', 'Arsenal-Players', 'Bayern Munich-Trophies' exist
Questions exist for club-specific categories (verified Manchester United-History, Arsenal-Players, Bayern Munich-History)
matchmaking_endpoints: POST /api/matchmaking/join adds user to queue with skill_rank
GET /api/matchmaking/status returns waiting state with wait_time, skill_range, players_in_queue
POST /api/matchmaking/bot-fallback creates bot game when no opponent found
Skill range expands over time (starts at ±150, expands by 50 every 15s up to ±500)
elo_calculation: Leaderboard shows skill_rank for all users
Game response includes skill_rank for both players
ELO changes calculated when non-bot ranked game finishes (verified in code)
frontend_matchmaking_ui: Ranked Match section shows 'Skill-based matchmaking • Your rank: 1000'
Find Ranked Match button triggers matchmaking search
Search state shows Wait Time, Skill Range (±150), In Queue count
Cancel Search button stops matchmaking and returns to initial state
Quick Play button available for instant bot matches

categories_added: And more for Inter Milan, AC Milan, Juventus, PSG, Marseille, etc.

elo_ranking_system.triggers_on: Non-bot, non-self games when game finishes

frontend_matchmaking_ui.bot_offer: Appears after 120s timeout with 'Play vs TheScore90Bot' option
